question: Giddha and Bhangra are the folk dances of which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Giddha:-**

 
 
• It is a **female folk dance** that is performed by **women in a circle** while clapping and singing traditional songs.
 
• It represents the** joy and celebration of life.**
 
 
 
• **Bhangra**:-
 
 
• It is a **male folk dance** that is performed with the** beat of dhol **and is characterized by **energetic movements and jumps.**
 
• It is performed to celebrate the harvest season and is considered a symbol of Punjabi culture.
 
 
 
• **Giddha and Bhangra are popular folk dances of Punjab and are performed during various cultural festivals and occasions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gujarat has **Garba and Dandiya.**
 
• Jharkhand has **Chhau and Karma.**
 
• Bihar has **Jhumar and Bidesia** as their popular folk dances.
